title: docs(stylex): record where the migration stands on 2026-10-28
body:
## What changed

- **ADR 0008 status**: stages 0–2b shipped (PRs #212–#227); web roadmap, auth and dashboard on StyleX (web-v0.11.0); stages 3–4 planned. The line still said "2b–4 planned".
- **`backlog/stylex-migration.md`**: status note updated, and a new dated section "Where it stands (2026-10-28)" with the per-surface table (what is on StyleX, what is still on CSS Modules or Tailwind), the four-week bundle comparison at `78f6deac` vs `cf478229` and why it is not a migration measurement, the production stylesheet table for kaipu.app, and the two claims the migration does not support (the first-paint fix predates it; "performance went up" has no controlled measurement).
- **`backlog/technical-debt.md`**: new entry, the web ships one StyleX sheet (973 rules, 56 KB raw, 11 KB gzip) for every route.

## What to review

The numbers. They were measured today, one run each, on the author's machine; the ledger says so. The StyleX sheet claim ("every route loads every atomic") comes from the PostCSS scanner's behaviour and from the built sheet's contents; it was not verified by splitting it.

## Not in this PR

No code. The desktop renderer JS nearly doubling between the two commits is recorded as unexplained, not investigated.
